correctness.rationale: Analytical Lagrange cubic and second variation give strict one-outlier maximizers of the constrained zero-sum fourth moment, uniformly C2-stable under the log-cosh expansion. Full permutation symmetry makes the optimizer stationary at positive levels. All-direction L1 bounds and positive/negative mass concentration yield explicit proximity <=5eta+sqrt(2)eta^2 for every enclosing-sphere contact, and irreducible symmetry establishes the unrestricted Löwner ellipsoid. Standalone 5,436 finite numerical checks support but do not replace the proof.
